additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained, including the CONTEXT registration claims. These scoped NOT_APPLICABLE proposals neither establish overall executable correctness nor authorize deleting the separate duties.

The four XML-pair disputes remain unresolved in the supplied investigation, with no disagreeing dimensions identified. The present proposal distinguishes the supported existence of the duty from the missing schema needed to assess conformity. If authority availability is intended to concern only establishing this atomic duty, NONE_DECLARED is an alternative; MISSING here records the expressly referenced external schema without making it necessary to answer the trigger question.

Footnote 3 has anchors in both da12aecad4e68.u4.1003 and da12aecad4e68.u5.1078. The extraction's absent-anchor uncertainty is resolved. Extending the e-Cert requirement to every submission method or every resubmission is unsupported. Absence of an anchor on the web-form option also does not establish an exemption from requirements outside this packet.

Registration, XML-schema conformity and e-Cert use are not stated prerequisites to the resubmission trigger. Adding them as necessary trigger operands would impose unsupported restrictions. Omitting them from these trigger formulas does not establish overall submission compliance.

Node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 uses "[the fact filing_date] is greater than or equal to [date value 2026-02-02]", which includes filings before 9:00am that day. The source separately says "With effect from 2 February 2026" in da12aecad4e68.u3.811 and "upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026" in da12aecad4e68.u13.2131. The calendar-date and operational-launch readings of "following its implementation" remain distinct; these pair assessments do not settle that disagreement.

The operational-launch candidates use an inclusive 9:00am boundary. The source supports a 9:00am launch but does not expressly state the governing timezone or resolve exact-boundary inclusion in the resubmission provision. What authoritative JFIU clarification or applicable time convention resolves those points? Any necessary additional authority is absent and has no identifiable supplied dependency mapping.

The blackout provision in da12aecad4e68.u12.1941 directs urgent submitters to contact JFIU. It does not establish that every email, telephone call or fax constitutes an actual STR submission, nor grant a general post-launch alternative-channel permission. Automatic migration under da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 likewise does not itself establish a new submission event.

Actual STR filing appears in the scope of nodes node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098, node.8c5e0d91275b795d477f7913 and node.8caddb7a4c29338c1d340db1. Node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb instead puts submission in its result. A licensed actor's nonfiling event can therefore produce OUT_OF_SCOPE versus FALSE. Equivalence requires an established assessment domain that excludes such events.

Node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3 delegates event existence, temporal interpretation, channel classification and sufficient-history assessment to a supplied Boolean. Its executable result is "Result: the fact report_has_postlaunch_other_channel_submission"; the formula does not perform an existential search. Incomplete history without an observed qualifying event must not be treated as an established FALSE. Attribution to the report's responsible entity also requires care when different entities made different submissions.

These typed questions concern historical DUTY_TRIGGER results. A later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase an earlier triggering event, while historical TRUE does not establish that the resulting duty remains outstanding. "Declared output convention: TRUE_IS_SATISFIED" must retain the typed meaning of trigger existence rather than compliance.

The XML provision also requires firms to liaise with JFIU as soon as possible to arrange a technical test. The schema claim is supported as an atomic extraction but does not exhaust da12aecad4e68.u14.2439. This additional action remains separate from the trigger questions.

JFIU's promised resubmission guidance in da12aecad4e68.u28.3334 is absent and has no identifiable supplied dependency mapping. Can the guidance and its applicable version be supplied for any assessment of performance or discharge? The source does not make issuance of that guidance a prerequisite to the stated duty.

All four supplied external dependencies have null source_hash values and no identifying metadata. None qualifies as AVAILABLE or can safely be matched to the XML schema, resubmission guidance or timezone authority. Source unit IDs are evidence identifiers, not external dependency IDs.

The declared UNKNOWN, CONFLICT and scope semantics are distinct from the legal trigger conditions. In particular, a conflicting dependency blocks evaluation even if another operand would otherwise determine the Boolean result. These scoped claim checks do not independently validate that runtime policy.
